summary: NeOnc Technologies Holdings, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to register 555,554 shares of common stock (277,777 shares and 277,777 shares issuable upon warrant exercise) for resale by a selling stockholder under existing registration rights. The shares were issued in a private placement on April 20, 2026. The filing is a routine shelf takedown for resale, not a special situation event. The company bears registration costs; the selling stockholder pays selling commissions. No strategic change, acquisition, or restructuring is present. This is a typical registered resale filing with no deal terms beyond registration mechanics.
